# One Set-Cookie header per line. Every value here is a canary that must never appear in output.
sessionid=CANARY-session-value; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax
prefs=CANARY-prefs; Max-Age=3600
__Host-id=CANARY-host; Secure; Path=/
__Host-bad=CANARY-hostbad; Secure; Domain=example.test; Path=/
__Secure-x=CANARY-secure
track=CANARY-track; SameSite=None
weird=CANARY-weird; SameSite=Bogus; HttpOnly; Secure
novalue
=CANARY-noname; Secure
bad name=CANARY-space
